text:
Rae: Quick sync — we need one crisp hero for the benchmark push: scatter (p95 ms vs $/1k tokens), small inset table for seq 64/256/1024, and a link to a micro-calculator. Target: social + webinar landing, soft-launch Mon.
Diego: I can export p50/p95 and cost for hosted/dedicated/private. Hero seq=256; will include quantized series as dashed lines. CSV+JSON by tomorrow AM.
June: Audience: devs (social) and infra/platform (webinar). Landing should have two CTAs: "Try API" and "Request Consult" with UTMs. We'll A/B test two headlines for 48h.
Lin: Visual plan: hero 1200x628 + 800x800. Scatter with 3 colors; avoid tiny labels. I'll mock by EOD and share color variants (brand-blue, teal, slate).
Harper: Add a small product callout: "Smart routing keeps p95 stable during spikes (demo in webinar)". Ops teams need the before/after example.
Diego: Note: quantization lowers $/1k but can affect tail latency. I'll add a footnote "based on benchmarked configs" and raw numbers on the landing.
Rae: Copy options: A) "Predictable p95. Predictable spend." B) "Serve fast, control spend." Vote?
June: A -> webinar/landing; B -> social ads. CTA text: "See benchmark & calc" / "Book capacity consult".
Lin: Design constraint: no legal text on the image. Put qualifiers/download link on landing. Also provide grayscale slide-safe assets.
Diego: Deliverables: CSV+JSON + small p50/p95 table for slide by tomorrow AM. I'll annotate any "up to" claims.
June: Routing: utm_campaign=bench_q1, utm_content=headlineA/B; hidden form field for company size to route enterprise leads.
notify-bot: Calendar "Bench Launch Review" created for Fri 09:30.
Rae: Action items: @Diego data exports, @Lin mockups, @June landing + UTMs + email cadence, @Harper webinar outline. Review Friday. Flag any risky claims in-thread. :rocket:
